title: Digital Delivery and Balance Inquiry — Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards Help-Desk Sheet
content:
Digital Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards reach their holder through a delivery channel, and the balance of every kind can be checked through a set of inquiry channels. The sheet below sets out, per card kind, how a digital card is delivered, how many calendar days ahead an eGift delivery can be scheduled, whether an email that did not arrive can be resent to a corrected address, and where the balance can be checked.

| Card kind | Digital delivery channels | Furthest scheduled delivery (calendar days ahead) | Undelivered email can be resent to a corrected address | Balance inquiry channels |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Not applicable | Not applicable | No | Online, app, automated phone line, phone agent, in store |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | Email; text message | 90 | Yes | Online, app, automated phone line, phone agent, in store |
| Merchandise Credit Card | Not applicable | Not applicable | No | Online, app, automated phone line, phone agent, in store |
| Registry Reward Card | Email | Not applicable | Yes | Online, app, automated phone line, phone agent, in store |
| Corporate Gift Card | Not applicable | Not applicable | No | Online, app, automated phone line, phone agent, in store |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | Not applicable | Not applicable | No | Online, app, automated phone line, phone agent, in store |

## Questions on the sheet

**How does a Marlowe & Finch eGift Card reach the recipient?** By email or by text message, and its delivery can be scheduled up to 90 calendar days ahead.

**How does a Registry Reward Card reach the registrant?** By email. No scheduled-delivery window is stated for it.

**For which kinds can an email that did not arrive be resent to a corrected address?** The Marlowe & Finch eGift Card and the Registry Reward Card. For the four plastic kinds there is no email to resend.

**Where can a balance be checked?** For all six kinds, in the same five channels: online at mfinch.com, in the Marlowe & Finch app, on the automated phone line, with a phone agent, and in store.

### Hypothetical scheduling dates

A hypothetical eGift order placed on 1 June may name a delivery date as late as 30 August, which is 90 calendar days ahead; 31 August, 91 days ahead, is beyond the window.
